# Template: Weekly Limits Log

Both tool plans are capped by a five-hour window plus a weekly cap, and published allowances are incomplete. A couple of lines a week shows your real allowance. Copy the table into `docs/limits-log.md` in your own working repository (or keep one log for all projects) and add a row per week.

| Week starting | Tool | Hit a cap? (5-hour or weekly) | When | What it interrupted | What I changed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | | | |

Review monthly. If a tool is capped often during the spec, plan or security review, those stages are being starved: move routine edits to the other tool first.
